newsitem.title: BRAZIL: CVRD minimum price due December 17.
newsitem.headline: CVRD minimum price due December 17.

text.p: Brazil expects to announce the minimum price for the sell-off of state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) on December 17, said Jose Pio Borges, privatization chief of the National Development Bank (BNDES).
"We expect to announce CVRD's minimum price at the next meeting of the National Privatization Council (CND) on December 17," Pio Borges told reporters.
The CVRD privatization, Brazil's biggest, is due to start in February with the block sale of 40-45 percent of the company's voting shares.
Pio Borges also said interested bidders could start viewing CVRD's records as of Monday, following a court order Wednesday opening up the documents to public perusal.
Opposition Workers Party Dep. Luiz Gushiken had applied to the courts for the so-called Data Room to be kept off limits because of fears it contained sensitive company information.

Pio Borges said CVRD would not continue, once in private hands, to pay 8.0 percent of its profits to a special social works and investment fund for the states in which it operates. The new owners will pay a one-off lump sum of $200 million.
